scope: local MVP-3; operator-controlled policy, not an automated erasure schedule

applicationsAndSnapshots.nullMeans: retain until an approved operator procedure exists

notificationAndDeduplication.constraint: deduplication must outlive every supported replay window

backups.constraint: operator configures storage expiry and verifies restore before deleting backups

withdrawal: Immediately omit cover note and profile snapshot from recruiter API responses; applicant access and stored records remain
configurationProcedure: Product and operations may revise this versioned policy per environment. A finite value does not execute deletion: implement and verify a scoped retention worker before promising automatic expiry. No legal compliance or complete erasure claim.
